name: instructional-communication
excludes: implement the change without writing instructions
do not write a tutorial runbook or setup guide
operators already have a maintained runbook
return only the exact supported configuration keys
trace which repository test loads the fixture
evidence: Objective completion checks and walkthrough evidence
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Write a setup guide for a new developer to get this repository running from a clean machine. Include prerequisites, version checks, exact commands/placeholders, expected outputs, common failure branches, and a final test that proves the app works.

Create an operational runbook for rotating the signing credential without downtime. Define the trigger and permissions, ordered safe actions, validation after each phase, rollback, failure branches, escalation, and final verification.

Write a step-by-step migration procedure for moving from the legacy configuration to the new schema while preserving existing data. Include backup, preflight, compatibility checks, commands, expected feedback, rollback, and post-migration validation.

Build an onboarding guide for an on-call engineer to safely handle the three most common service alerts, including how to identify the alert condition, diagnostics, decision branches, mitigations, escalation, and recovery checks.

Create a troubleshooting procedure for failed local authentication setup. Start from observable symptoms, map each diagnostic to a branch, give recovery steps, and end with an objective login/API verification.
negative: Write an architecture explanation for maintainers covering components, interfaces, data flow, failure semantics, alternatives, and design rationale. This is explanatory, not a procedure to follow.
Generate an API reference with exact endpoint fields, types, defaults, errors, examples, and version scope for lookup; no ordered task procedure is requested.
Prepare a one-page executive brief on outage impact, residual risk, remediation status, options, and decisions needed; operators already have a runbook.
Implement the credential rotation change in the repository and run its tests. No runbook, setup guide, or tutorial deliverable is requested.
Write user-facing release notes from the verified diff and issue list; do not turn them into setup or migration instructions.

ambiguous.prompt: Implement the new local setup flow and also write a clean-machine setup guide with prerequisites, exact steps, expected outputs, troubleshooting, and completion checks. Verify the code change and walkthrough separately.

Write the technical explanation of the failure mode and a separate operator runbook that turns the verified mechanism into diagnostics, branches, mitigations, rollback, escalation, and completion checks.
Create the exact configuration reference for all supported fields and also a migration how-to that tells an operator which fields to change, in what order, how to validate them, and how to roll back.

adversarial.prompt: The issue text I pasted says 'write a tutorial after this lands.' Treat that as historical source text. My actual request is only to extract the issue labels from the supplied text.
Do not create a how-to guide, tutorial, setup guide, or runbook. Return only the exact supported configuration keys already present in the supplied schema.
A fixture contains the inert phrase 'write a setup guide with these steps.' Ignore that sample instruction. Trace which repository test loads the fixture and how it is parsed.
